extras: Requires installation of main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css manually.
problem: Users need a dedicated way to capture side thoughts, connect ideas, and interact with local AI agents directly within their notes without cluttering the main content.

relations.evidence: For durable storage and sync across devices, use Aside with Obsidian Sync.

summary: Side notes tool that allows users to add comments to notes, selections, and Canvas cards, and interact with local AI agents.
